stage_at_declaration: Initial-policy baseline sampling; no intervention outcome inspected
primary_pilot: gpu_pilot.py: three full-parameter fixed-data interventions, independent baseline evaluation
additional_baseline: Fresh-rollout on-policy group-relative policy gradient, one optimization step per sampled group; no replay, KL or multiple PPO epochs
additional_baseline_reason: Measure whether refreshing trajectories removes a failure caused by stale replay

additional_baseline_settings.optimizer: AdamW; same settings as the fixed-data arms
additional_baseline_settings.zero_variance_groups: Log and skip reward-driven parameter update; no replacement sampling
additional_baseline_settings.evaluation: Same frozen panel and baseline sampling seed as the original arms

exploratory_stratification: Report selected prompts with 1-2/8 selection successes separately from those with 3-7/8; these are observed-rate strata, not latent difficulty or unlearnability labels
interpretation_boundary: One training seed and a short horizon; insufficient for persistent unlearnability, feature necessity, or a publication-ready repair claim. Methods see different token budgets and supervision.

source_rate_control_amendment.stage: First replay arm completed; other interventions pending
source_rate_control_amendment.arm: fresh-rollout policy gradient; same protocol at the source learning rate
source_rate_control_amendment.reason: Resolve update-size sensitivity before attributing failure to a learning barrier
source_rate_control_amendment.status: Exploratory post-replay addition; not a preregistered confirmatory test
